meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi 提示时,它会先查实时提示列表、核对你的 settings.json 和提示历史判断你实际能看到哪些,再读对应功能源码,用你提问的语言给出带具体文件路径的深入解释。
howto.when: 当你问某条提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或想知道自己能遇到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 "Tip:" 是什么意思?
say.note: 它会查实时提示列表并读源码解释

say.text: 我实际能看到哪些提示?为什么看不到别的?
say.note: 它会读你的 settings.json 和提示历史

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条提示是怎么来的?
say.note: 它会讲检测、类别门槛和隐藏指令的链路

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, it queries the live tip list, checks your settings.json and tip history to see which tips you can actually see, then reads the feature's source code and explains it in your language, citing exact file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a tip means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What was that "Tip:" line I just saw?
say_en.note: It queries the live tip list and reads the source

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see, and why not others?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json and tips history

say_en.text: Where did that tip after a Fable 5 refusal come from?
say_en.note: It walks through detection, the gate, and the hidden directive
